Bug_Title: Unnecessary boxing and unboxing should be avoided
Bug_Explanation: The code demonstrates unnecessary boxing and unboxing operations. Boxing converts primitives to their wrapper objects and unboxing does the reverse. These operations are redundant when Java's auto-boxing and auto-unboxing can handle conversions implicitly. The code contains explicit boxing and unboxing when it's unnecessary.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the method showBug on the BoxingUnboxingExample class, which contains lines of code that unnecessarily use boxing and unboxing, triggering the bug.
